newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK Jan exports down 7.4 pct, re-exports up 2.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK Jan exports down 7.4 pct, re-exports up 2.6 pct.

text.p: The volume of domestic exports in January fell 7.4 percent on year, while re-exports rose 2.6 percent, Census and Statistics Department data showed.
Total export volume rose 1.0 percent and import volume increased by 3.0 percent.
Prices of domestic exports fell 1.5 percent in January 1997 from a year earlier and re-export prices decreased 1.3 percent, import prices decreased by 2.4 percent.
Volume of domestic exports for the three months ending January dropped by 7.6 percent while that of re-exports leapt 5.5 percent. Imports were up 5.1 percent.

Prices are based on unit values which do not take into account changes in the composition or quality of goods traded, except for some selected commodities for which specific price indices are available.
